# RFC 2578 section 3.7 ends a comment at a second pair of hyphens or at
# the end of the line, whichever comes first. The two comments here run
# on past their first line, which their author could only have meant
# under the paired rule: read under the end-of-line rule, each one's
# continuation is live text that frames into a declaration nothing can
# classify.
#
# So the file is read twice, and the reading that loses less wins. The
# diagnostic records which rule produced the result, because a reader
# comparing this module against its source needs to know which way the
# hyphens were taken.
code smi/paired-comment-mode
